warnings: Insufficient pitch agreement for reliable alignment; discrepancies are candidates and tempo feedback is withheld.
Alignment is monotone and heuristic. Repeated identical passages, skipped/replayed bars, and partial takes can be ambiguous; inspect matches before grading.
Audio detections have uncalibrated confidence; discrepancies may come from transcription rather than playing.
